title: Tesla and SpaceX Committed $16.8 Billion to One Chip Plant. Tesla's Entire Annual Profit Is $3.8 Billion.
excerpt: The first phase of Terafab costs more than four times what the electric-car maker earned over the past year.
content_html:
Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) and SpaceX (NASDAQ: SPCX) said on Aug. 6 that they will spend $16.8 billion on the first phase of Terafab, a semiconductor plant in Grimes County, Texas. Tesla's net income over the past 12 months was about $3.8 billion -- so the two companies' opening commitment alone is more than four times what Tesla currently earns in a year.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

The plan is enormous even by chip-industry standards. Terafab is designed to put logic, memory, packaging, and testing under one roof, across more than 100 million square feet, about an hour northwest of Houston. The companies say the site will draw water from the Gibbons Creek Reservoir rather than local groundwater.

The chips are meant for Tesla's Optimus robots and its Cybercab, plus the high-power processors SpaceX wants for space-based data centers. Elon Musk is CEO of both companies, and Tesla said on X that it and SpaceX will need far more chips than current and future global production can supply.

What neither company has said is how the bill divides. The announcement attributes the $16.8 billion to the two companies jointly. And the first phase is only the start -- the project has been described in SpaceX's Texas tax-incentive filings as a multiphase plan that could reach $119 billion.

But even a half share would be a large number against Tesla's current results. For perspective, Tesla spent about $12.9 billion on capital expenditures over the past 12 months, generated $5.8 billion of free cash flow, and earned $3.8 billion of net income.

An $8.4 billion share of phase one would equal about two-thirds of a full year's capital spending, layered on top of the vehicle programs and artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure that spending already covers.

Tesla can write the check. The company finished the second quarter with about $43.5 billion of cash and investments on hand, so the balance sheet can absorb a project like this. The strain shows up first in cash flow, and only later in earnings, as depreciation on a plant that size runs through an already thin profit base.

And the chips Terafab is built to make are mostly for products that don't ship at scale yet: Optimus and Cybercab on Tesla's side, orbital data centers on SpaceX's. The plant is a bet that those businesses grow large enough to absorb its output.

content_html_zh:
特斯拉（纳斯达克股票代码：TSLA）和SpaceX（纳斯达克股票代码：SPCX）8月6日表示，他们将斥资168亿美元建设位于德克萨斯州格莱姆斯县的半导体工厂Terafab一期工程。 特斯拉过去 12 个月的净利润约为 38 亿美元——因此，仅两家公司的期初承诺就超过了特斯拉目前年收入的四倍多。

错过了 2009 年的 Nvidia？ 这个罕见的信号再次闪烁。 2009年，一家名不见经传的芯片制造商英伟达发出了“双倍下跌”的信号。 多年来，对于一家规模仅为 Nvidia 1/100 的公司来说，同样的“完全确信”信号闪烁。 继续 ”

即使按照芯片行业的标准来看，这个计划也是巨大的。 Terafab 旨在将逻辑、内存、封装和测试集中在一个屋檐下，占地超过 1 亿平方英尺，距离休斯顿西北约一小时车程。 两家公司表示，该地点将从吉本斯溪水库取水，而不是当地地下水。

这些芯片适用于特斯拉的 Optimus 机器人及其 Cyber​​cab，以及 SpaceX 想要用于太空数据中心的高功率处理器。 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 是两家公司的首席执行官，特斯拉在 X 上表示，它和 SpaceX 所需的芯片数量将远远超出当前和未来全球产能的供应量。

两家公司都没有透露该法案如何分配。 该公告将 168 亿美元归两家公司共同所有。 第一阶段只是开始——SpaceX 在德克萨斯州的税收激励文件中将该项目描述为一个多阶段计划，规模可能达到 1190 亿美元。

但与特斯拉目前的业绩相比，即使是一半的份额也已经是一个很大的数字了。 从长远来看，特斯拉在过去 12 个月的资本支出约为 129 亿美元，产生了 58 亿美元的自由现金流，并赚取了 38 亿美元的净利润。

第一阶段的 84 亿美元份额相当于全年资本支出的约三分之二，该支出是在车辆项目和人工智能 (AI) 基础设施支出已经涵盖的基础上进行的。

特斯拉可以开支票。 该公司第二季度末手头现金和投资约为 435 亿美元，因此资产负债表可以消化这样的项目。 这种压力首先体现在现金流方面，然后才体现在收益方面，因为如此规模的工厂的折旧会影响到本已微薄的利润基础。

Terafab 生产的芯片主要用于尚未大规模出货的产品：特斯拉方面的 Optimus 和 Cyber​​cab，SpaceX 方面的轨道数据中心。 该工厂的赌注是这些企业发展得足够大以吸收其产出。
